verdict.rationale: Mixpanel is an analytics SaaS, not an agent, so the official-MCP-server axis applies. Its docs describe a hosted MCP server that gives AI assistants direct access to Mixpanel data, with natural-language querying of events, funnels, retention and session replays, and tools such as Create-Dashboard. A probe independently confirmed the MCP documentation page exists. Missing for 10: independent hands-on or community corroboration of agent connections, and documented auth/setup details for connecting clients.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Mixpanel provides a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that gives AI assistants direct access to your Mixpanel data.
Once connected, you can query events, funnels, flows, retention, session replays, and more using natural language — no dashboard navigation required.
Create-Dashboard | Create a new dashboard with text cards and reports
official MCP server documented at https://docs.mixpanel.com/docs/mcp
